description: Self-healing runs with a safety gate: a run-failure sensor (or, for runs recorded without a failure event, a run-record sensor) gathers redacted evidence and requests a triage run on a dynamic partition; an approval sensor turns the triage pipeline's proposal into a pending approval (agentic_pipeline/agent_review_queue compatible) and, only with a token bound to that exact proposal, executes allow-listed actions (retry_run, rerun_partition, materialize_assets, open_ticket, notify) and records whether they fixed the failure.

inputs.description: Failed runs (run-failure sensor) and triage proposals (JSON files in proposals_dir).

outputs.description: Sensors + jobs: evidence JSON, triage run requests, approval records, remediation run requests, results JSON with fixed/not_fixed outcomes.

evidence_dir.label: Evidence Dir
evidence_dir.description: Where evidence JSON is written (<dir>/<run_id>.json): a local path or fsspec URI (s3://, gs://, abfs://). The triage pipeline reads it (agentic_pipeline: `source: {kind: file, path: <dir>/{partition_key}.json}`, local paths only).

proposals_dir.label: Proposals Dir
proposals_dir.description: Where the triage pipeline writes proposals (<dir>/<run_id>.json): {run_id, summary, root_cause, confidence, actions:[{kind, params, reason}]}.

approval_dir.label: Approval Dir
approval_dir.description: Approval directory (same layout as agentic_pipeline's `approve` op): pending records in <dir>/pending/<run_id>.json, tokens at <dir>/<run_id>.json. agent_review_queue can list it.

results_dir.label: Results Dir
results_dir.description: Where execution results + outcomes are recorded (<dir>/<run_id>.json).

triage_job_name.label: Triage Job Name
triage_job_name.description: Name of the TRIAGE job this component defines over `triage_asset_selection` (a job request per failed run, partition = the failed run id).

triage_asset_selection.label: Triage Asset Selection
triage_asset_selection.description: Asset selection string for the triage job (e.g. 'key:run_triage*' or 'group:triage'): the dynamically partitioned assets of your triage pipeline.

triage_run_config.label: Triage Run Config
triage_run_config.description: Run config passed to every triage run request.

dynamic_partitions_name.label: Dynamic Partitions Name
dynamic_partitions_name.description: Name of the DynamicPartitionsDefinition the failed run ids are registered on. The triage assets must use this same name (agentic_pipeline: partition_type: dynamic, dynamic_partition_name: <this>).

only_jobs.label: Only Jobs
only_jobs.description: Only triage failures of these jobs (default: all jobs in all code locations).

ignore_jobs.label: Ignore Jobs
ignore_jobs.description: Never triage failures of these jobs. The triage job itself is always ignored (no recursion).

detect.label: Detect
detect.description: How failed runs are detected: `events` (default; Dagster's run_failure_sensor, RUN_FAILURE events), `runs` (a sensor polling run records with status FAILURE -- also sees runs written to run storage without a failure event), or `both` (a run is never triaged twice). dagster-airlift's Airflow runs emit the event, so `events` already covers them.

only_tags.label: Only Tags
only_tags.description: Only triage failed runs carrying ALL of these tags: {tag_key: value}; value '*' (or '') matches any value. E.g. {'dagster-airlift/airflow-dag-id': '*'}. Applies to every detection mode.

runs_lookback_hours.label: Runs Lookback Hours
runs_lookback_hours.description: detect runs|both: how far back (by the run's last update time) the run-record sensor looks for failed runs it has not judged yet.

runs_max_per_tick.label: Runs Max Per Tick
runs_max_per_tick.description: detect runs|both: at most this many new failed runs are triaged per tick (oldest first); the rest wait for the next tick.

triage_remediation_runs.label: Triage Remediation Runs
triage_remediation_runs.description: Also triage failures of runs this component launched. Off by default so a failing retry cannot start another triage.

max_triage_per_hour.label: Max Triage Per Hour
max_triage_per_hour.description: Rate limit: at most this many triage runs requested per rolling hour.

cooldown_minutes.label: Cooldown Minutes
cooldown_minutes.description: After a triage for (job, error signature), further failures with the same signature are suppressed for this long.

history_runs.label: History Runs
history_runs.description: How many recent runs of the same job to include in the evidence.

recent_outcomes.label: Recent Outcomes
recent_outcomes.description: How many recent remediation outcomes (same job or error signature) to include in the evidence.

log_tail_chars.label: Log Tail Chars
log_tail_chars.description: Max characters of each step's error message kept (the tail).

redact_patterns.label: Redact Patterns
redact_patterns.description: Extra regexes to redact from evidence, results, tickets and webhook payloads (on top of the built-in token/key/password/Authorization/base64/env-secret rules).

allowed_actions.label: Allowed Actions
allowed_actions.description: Allow-list of action kinds a proposal may use: retry_run, rerun_partition, materialize_assets, open_ticket, notify. Anything else is rejected with a recorded reason. Default: the safe ones (retry_run, rerun_partition, open_ticket).

allowed_materialize_assets.label: Allowed Materialize Assets
allowed_materialize_assets.description: When materialize_assets is allowed, restrict it to these asset keys (e.g. ['raw/orders']). Default: any asset in the code location.

max_actions_per_proposal.label: Max Actions Per Proposal
max_actions_per_proposal.description: Actions beyond this count in one proposal are rejected.

max_retries_per_run.label: Max Retries Per Run
max_retries_per_run.description: retry_run launches at most this many retries for one failure (the chain's root run).

remediation_jobs.label: Remediation Jobs
remediation_jobs.description: The jobs retry_run / rerun_partition / materialize_assets launch runs through: {name: asset selection string}, e.g. {core: 'group:core', daily: 'group:daily'}. Each becomes job `<name_prefix>_remediate_<name>`. A Dagster sensor can only request runs for the jobs it targets, and one job needs assets with one partitions definition (unpartitioned assets mix freely), so group your assets accordingly. Without this, those three actions are rejected with a recorded reason (open_ticket / notify still work).

approval_step_id.label: Approval Step Id
approval_step_id.description: Step id used in the approval fingerprint / pending record (shown by agent_review_queue).

approval_max_age_hours.label: Approval Max Age Hours
approval_max_age_hours.description: An approval token older than this is expired. Default: no expiry.

auto_approve.label: Auto Approve
auto_approve.description: OFF by default. {kinds: [retry_run], max_per_hour: 3, min_confidence: 0.8}: proposals whose every action is in `kinds` and whose confidence is high enough are approved by the policy itself (token approver: auto_approve), at most max_per_hour per rolling hour.

webhook_url_env_var.label: Webhook Url Env Var
webhook_url_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable holding the webhook URL used by `notify` (never logged or written).

ticket_webhook_url_env_var.label: Ticket Webhook Url Env Var
ticket_webhook_url_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable holding a webhook URL that also receives each `open_ticket` ticket (never logged or written).

outcome_check_after_minutes.label: Outcome Check After Minutes
outcome_check_after_minutes.description: How long after an action launched runs to judge whether it fixed the failure (outcome: fixed | not_fixed).

store_resource_key.label: Store Resource Key
store_resource_key.description: Optional resource key of a ContextReceiptStore: when a proposal carries a `receipt_id`, the outcome is also recorded with `record_outcome`. Skipped cleanly when absent.

default_status.label: Default Status
default_status.description: Initial sensor status: STOPPED (default) or RUNNING.

name: run_failure_remediation
